title: Stability runbook — weekly synth & hotpatch handoff
content:
Meeting: Release / Stability weekly synth + hotpatch handoff
Date: 2026-03-12 10:00am PT (Sync notes, informal)
Location: #release-ops and shiproom bridge
Owner: Ravi Kapoor (release engineer)

Attendees:
- Ravi Kapoor (owner)
- Maya Chen (SRE lead)
- Elena Park (serving-runtime)
- Jonah Lee (release-conductor)
- Priya Malhotra (oncall rotation)
- Ad-hoc: Dana (support), Marcus (solutions eng)

Purpose:
- Weekly synthesis of release train status, outstanding hotfixes, and immediate post-deploy checks.
- Handoff actionable hotpatches to on-call / shiproom for next 48h window.
- Confirm canary metrics and rollback triggers for upcoming minor rollout (v0.17.3 -> v0.17.4).

High-level summary:
- Release train: v0.17.x steady; we are in the 3rd day of the minor rollout to EU region. Overall traffic routed correctly, token-cost telemetry green.
- New regressions: small uptick in top-level LLM request 95th latency in eu-west-1 on long-context jobs (>=4096 tokens) after kernel swap. Root cause suspected kernel selection suboptimal for quantized llama-variants.
- Hotfix queue: 3 current hotpatch candidates (see list). One (RI-4127) escalated to P1 due to increased error rate for embeddings API in Dedicated tenants.

Agenda items and notes:
1) Canary progress for v0.17.4 rollforward
   - Started canary 03/10; 5% traffic -> 15% yesterday -> 35% today. No traffic migration failures.
   - Canary metrics baseline: p95 latency, 5xx rate, GPU utilization, KV cache hitrate.
   - Current anomalies: p95 latency +12% vs baseline on long-context jobs in eu-west-1. 5xx steady at 0.02% (acceptable).
   - Decision: pause further ramp to 50% until kernel selector revert test. Jonah + Elena to run A/B with previous kernel selection on subset of canary pods. Target: 6-hour test window.

2) Hotpatch triage (short list)
   - RI-4127 (P1): embeddings failures for dedicated-tenant "AcmeHealth". Error: OOM in dedicated pool during batching spike. Current mitigation: reduce max-batch-size to 32 and scale dedicated pool by 2 nodes.
     - Owner: Priya
     - Actions: immediate config change (done 03/12 09:45) + monitoring for 2h. If errors drop <0.1% keep. If not, fallback to model-variant "embed-buf64".
     - Rollback: restore max-batch-size and scale-down orchestration if customer impact persists; follow up with billing/ops for cost delta.

   - RI-4150 (P2): regression in streaming chunk ordering for multi-line tool calls. Intermittent garble observed when rate limit tokens cross 1M/min for user sessions.
     - Owner: Elena
     - Actions: add additional ordering checks in streaming proxy; schedule patch for 03/13 deploy window.
     - Notes: low customer impact; target fix in next patch train.

   - RI-4162 (P3): console dashboard chart stale data for route "/v1/generate" — caching TTL misconfigured.
     - Owner: Maya
     - Actions: quick config flip, add unit test to prevent regression; plan for hotfix in maintenance window.

3) Preflight checklist for next deploy (v0.17.4 -> majority traffic)
   - Validate model-variant compatibility map (Jonah) — done 03/12 08:30.
   - Canary rollback window defined: 2 hours after each ramp step.
   - Observability: dashboard cards pinned for this rollout (p95 latency, avg latency, 5xx, quota errors, KV cache hitrate).
   - Chaos gate: no active chaos during ramp.
   - Load test: short 30m spike test in staging shows no degradation for typical 1-2k token workloads. Long-context test repros p95 increase seen in prod.

4) Root cause hypothesis & mitigation plan (kernel selector + quantized path)
   - Hypothesis: recent kernel selection heuristic changed threshold for medium-long sequences; quantized kernels chosen that perform worse on sequences >4096 leading to slower attention kernels.
   - Immediate mitigation: revert heuristic for eu-west-1 canary pods (A/B) and re-evaluate.
   - Mid-term: add heuristics test in CI that runs representative long-context samples under selected kernels. Assign to Elena + Research infra.

5) Post-deploy validation steps (owners and timers)
   - 0–15m: sanity checks (route 200s, error spikes) — Priya
   - 15–60m: metric dive if p95 > baseline +10% — Maya + Jonah
   - 1–3h: smoke regression checks on embeddings endpoints for Dedicated tenants — Ravi
   - 3–24h: customer-facing monitoring and CS alerts — Marcus + Dana

Open risks and notes to triage later:
- Capacity radar: GPU pool utilization for eu-west-1 at 78% baseline; spike headroom limited. If kernel revert increases utilization significantly we may need temporary burst pool.
- Cost: scaling dedicated pools for hotfix increases monthly committed usage — finance notified (cc: finance slack).
- SLA impact window: if RI-4127 recurs, customer has legal escalations (support ticket #S-2298). Priority handling confirmed.

Action items (owner, ETA):
- Jonah: run A/B kernel selector test in canary subset (eu-west-1) and report by 03/12 18:00 PT.
- Elena: push streaming-proxy ordering checks PR and schedule for 03/13 maintenance window. PR: github.com/redwood/stream-proxy/pull/452. ETA 03/13 09:00.
- Priya: monitor RI-4127 after config change for 12h, escalate immediately if >0.5% errors.
- Maya: patch console TTL config and add test to pipeline. ETA 03/14.
- Ravi: compile incident brief if rollback occurs, include timeline + cost delta.
- Marcus/Dana: prepare CS advisory draft in case dedicated tenant sees further impact.

Quick checklist for shiproom when hotpatch applies:
- Confirm PRs merged and deployed to canary before ramp.
- Verify canary control group (previous kernel) vs experiment group (current kernel) placed on separate hosts to avoid noisy neighbor.
- Confirm alert thresholds lowered temporarily to catch small regressions (p95 +8% alert).
- Keep rollback playbook pinned: steps include route cut, model-variant fallback, cluster scale, config revert; owners assigned.

Notes to self / shorthand scraps:
- "If canary p95 > baseline +10% -> HOLD and investigate kernel path" (we've been repeating)
- Consider adding synthetic long-context runner to Optimize pipeline to surface these regressions earlier.
- Need better visibility for dedicated pool batching behavior when autoscaler kicks in. TODO: convo with infra autoscaler owners.

Decisions captured:
- Pause ramp at 35% until A/B completes (Jonah + Elena).
- Immediate config mitigation for RI-4127 accepted and monitored (Priya).
- Streaming proxy fix scheduled for next maintenance window (Elena).

Follow-ups for next weekly synth (2026-03-19):
- Outcome of kernel selector A/B and whether rollforward proceeds.
- Post-mitigation metrics for RI-4127 and cost delta report.
- Progress on Optimize pipeline long-context test addition.

Links / shorthand references:
- Slack thread: slack.com/archives/C01RELEASE/threads/long-context-kernel-swap
- JIRA board: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RI-4127
- PRs: github.com/redwood/release-runner/pull/188, github.com/redwood/stream-proxy/pull/452

End of notes.

Informal / scratch lines (leave in doc for context):
- "watch eu-west-1 p95 after kernel revert — probably will spike GPU usage but should drop latency"
- "billing flagged the dedicated scale yesterday — finance ok with 48h emergency scale if we document"
- Unresolved: need better tagging of model-variants per tenant for fallback automation (ramps into roadmap).

---
Documented by Ravi Kapoor on 2026-03-12. Last updated 2026-03-13 with A/B test schedule and PR references.
